frozen_candidate_root_contribution: sh-h-d marks a single relational field with two internally-linked poles: (P1) firsthand co-presence / being-manifest to an awareness (being there, attending, perceiving; for God, omniscient direct access), and (P2) the authoritative affirmation that issues from such direct access (vouching, attesting, affirming). The witness (shaahid/shahiid) occupies this relation; the verb (I/IV/X) enacts or causes it; shahaadah is either the act/content of the affirmation or the intake pole nominalized as 'the manifest'; mashhuud/mashhad is its object. Which pole surfaces is selected by complement type (time/place/event NP -> presence; 'anna'/'bi-'/'alaa' + proposition -> attestation), not by any change in the root's force.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: sh-h-d marks a single relational field with two internally-linked poles: (P1) firsthand co-presence / being-manifest to an awareness (being there, attending, perceiving; for God, omniscient direct access), and (P2) the authoritative affirmation that issues from such direct access (vouching, attesting, affirming). The witness (shaahid/shahiid) occupies this relation; the verb (I/IV/X) enacts or causes it; shahaadah is either the act/content of the affirmation or the intake pole nominalized as 'the manifest'; mashhuud/mashhad is its object. Which pole surfaces is selected by complement type (time/place/event NP -> presence; 'anna'/'bi-'/'alaa' + proposition -> attestation), not by any change in the root's force.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root does not mean simply 'testify' nor simply 'be present' - both single glosses are disproven in opposite directions (2:185 'whoever is present for the month' and 74:13 'sons present' have no testimony; 3:18 God attesting tawhiid and the juridical shahaadah of 2:282 have no spatial attendance). Instead it names one relation whose two ends the Quran itself bridges: presence grounds testimony (43:19 moves from 'were they present at their creation' to 'their testimony will be written'; 12:81 'we attested only by what we knew'; 2:133/6:144 gloss shuhadaa' by 'were present when...'; 5:117 Jesus witnesses over his people 'only while I was among them'; 41:20 the very organs of perception testify). The one class that strains this unity is al-shahaadah as the 'manifest realm' paired with al-ghayb (10x), which is linked to the field only by antonymy inference and is recorded as a resistant seam.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT entail truth/veracity of the content (63:1 hypocrites' valid-form shahaadah is branded a lie in the same verse; 25:72 false witness is in range). Does NOT entail sincerity/inner assent (63:1; 2:204 the hypocrite 'calls God to witness what is in his heart'). Does NOT Quran-internally mean 'martyr / one slain in war' - the honored shuhadaa' (4:69, 57:19, 3:140) carry no internal tie to violent death and reduce to 'witnesses (to truth / at judgment)', cf. 39:69 where they are brought to function as witnesses. Does NOT mean 'see' specifically (presence can be aural: 50:37 'gives ear while present') and does NOT require verbal speech (2:185, 74:13, 4:72). Does NOT reduce to 'know' (43:19/12:81 co-predicate presence and knowledge but keep them distinct). Does NOT require a legal/court frame (cosmic, covenantal, creedal uses have zero juridical content).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The fixed pair 'aalimu l-ghaybi wa-l-shahaadah' (13:9:3:3 and 9 parallels) uses al-shahaadah as a reified cosmological domain (the manifest/perceptible realm, antonym of al-ghayb) with no agent, no event, and no act of attesting; no verse Quran-internally equates this domain-noun to any shahida act, so its unification with the witnessing field rests on cross-occurrence ghayb/shahaadah antonymy (inference), not on an internal demonstration.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A hard two-lexeme split: (A) a witnessing field (verb I/IV/X, shaahid, shahiid, shuhadaa', shahaadah=testimony, mashhuud) built on presence->attestation, versus (B) an autonomous nominal al-shahaadah = the perceptible realm (opp. al-ghayb). The split is attractive because the verb cleanly bifurcates by complement type and the 10 ghayb/shahaadah verses are internally self-sufficient with no act of witnessing. It is rejected for the witnessing field because the SAME lexemes (verb, shaahid, shahiid) populate both poles selected only by complement (a distributional, not lexical, split) and the Quran fuses the poles inside single clauses (5:117; 41:20-22; 12:81; 43:19; the 85:3 shaahid/mashhuud pair). It is CONCEDED, as a bound sub-sense, only for al-shahaadah=manifest-realm, whose bridge to the field is inferential rather than internally demonstrated.

The split is attractive because the verb cleanly bifurcates by complement type and the 10 ghayb/shahaadah verses are internally self-sufficient with no act of witnessing. It is rejected for the witnessing field because the SAME lexemes (verb, shaahid, shahiid) populate both poles selected only by complement (a distributional, not lexical, split) and the Quran fuses the poles inside single clauses (5:117; 41:20-22; 12:81; 43:19; the 85:3 shaahid/mashhuud pair). It is CONCEDED, as a bound sub-sense, only for al-shahaadah=manifest-realm, whose bridge to the field is inferential rather than internally demonstrated.
internal_discovery.rationale: Two independent bottom-up lenses (A, B) and an adversarial lens (C) converge that the witnessing field is one bridged nucleus, not homonymy: both single glosses are disproven, the same lexemes cover both poles by syntax, and multiple in-verse bridges fuse presence and attestation (43:19, 18:51, 12:81, 2:133, 6:144, 5:117, 41:20-22, 85:3). Distinctiveness holds Quran-internally against al-ghayb (direct antonymy), 'ilm (12:81 'attest only by what we knew'), raqiib (5:117 presence-bound shahiid vs oversight-in-absence), and bashiir/nadhiir (33:45, 48:8 list shaahid as a separate office). The only genuine seam - shared by the adversary - is al-shahaadah as the manifest realm (10x), unified with the field by ghayb-antonymy inference rather than by any internal equation; it is carved out as a RESISTANT seam rather than smoothed in. 25:72 is a real intra-field micro-ambiguity between the two poles. The root-wide nucleus therefore stands as STRONG, with the manifest-realm class and 25:72 recorded as first-class resistant limits.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I shahida enacts the one relation with pole selected by complement: presence/attendance with a time/place/event NP (2:185 shahida l-shahr; 24:2 wa-l-yashhad 'adhaabahumaa; 43:19 a-shahiduu khalqahum; 27:49 maa shahidnaa mahlik), and attestation/affirmation with 'anna'/'bi-'/'alaa' + proposition (3:18 shahida llaahu annahu; 63:1 nashhadu innaka; 6:130 shahidnaa 'alaa anfusinaa).
clusters.classification_rationale: One lexeme, two syntactically-conditioned poles; the same verb carries both, and 43:19 uses the presence-verb as the precondition of the testimony-noun in a single verse - the signature of one nucleus, not homonymy.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Presence: 2:185:14:1, 24:2:22:3, 43:19:8:2, 27:49:10:1. Attestation: 3:18:1:1, 63:1:5:1, 12:81:10:1, 41:20:5:1 (organs of perception testify - poles fused in one clause).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of both poles: make-present-at (18:51 maa ashhadtuhum khalqa l-samaawaat), and call/produce-to-witness (11:54 ushhidu llaaha; 2:282 wa-ashhiduu; 65:2; 7:172 fuses both: made-present then made-to-attest 'alaa anfusihim).
clusters.classification_rationale: The IV causative applies uniformly to the same two poles the base verb carries, confirming a single underlying relation rather than two unrelated senses.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Requestive/seek-derivation: summon or procure witnesses - wa-stashhiduu shahiidayni (2:282:52:2), fa-stashhiduu 'alayhinna arba'ah (4:15:6:2).
clusters.classification_rationale: Form X derives directly from the attestation pole (procuring persons who will attest from presence), internal to the same field.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The nominal system of the field: shaahid (act. part., present-one / attester), shahiid (fa'iil, full-cognizance witness - divine all-witness 'alaa kulli shay'in shahiid, community/messenger eschatological witness, legal witness, and bare presence 4:72/50:37), shuhadaa' (legal / present-at-event 2:133,6:144 / justice-upholders 4:135,5:8 / honorific class 4:69,57:19), shuhuud (present ones 74:13), shahaadah=testimony (act or content, 2:282,2:283,5:106-108,6:19), and passive mashhuud/mashhad/ashhaad (that which is witnessed/attended; witnesses at judgment 11:18,40:51). The 85:3 shaahid/mashhuud pair overtly couples the active and passive poles of one relation.
clusters.classification_rationale: The ADJ vs N tag is a parse artifact (identical shahiidan is tagged ADJ 6x and N 10x), so these are grouped as one lexical field, not by pos. All members instantiate the presence<->attestation relation; presence-only members (4:72, 74:13, 50:37, 2:133) and attestation members (2:282, 6:19) share lexemes with the verb, and 5:117 conditions the shahiid role on presence.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Divine all-witness: 22:17:22:1, 41:53:19:1. Bare presence: 4:72:17:1, 74:13:2:1, 50:37:13:1, 2:133:3:1. Testimony noun: 2:283:23:2, 6:19:5:1. Poles paired: 85:3:1:2 + 85:3:2:2. Presence conditions attestation: 5:117:15:1.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: al-shahaadah as a reified cosmological DOMAIN - 'the manifest / perceptible realm' - in the fixed pair 'aalimu l-ghaybi wa-l-shahaadah'. Agent-less, event-less, act-less; the transparent nominalization of the intake pole (that-which-is-present-to-perception), defined by direct antonymy to al-ghayb.
clusters.classification_rationale: Placeable in the field ONLY via cross-occurrence ghayb/shahaadah antonymy, which is an inference: no verse internally equates this domain-noun to any shahida act. The adversary is entitled to withhold assent on the internal bridge, so this class is recorded as a resistant seam rather than folded in.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 10 stable occurrences: 13:9:3:3, 23:92:3:3, 32:6:4:3, 39:46:8:3, 59:22:10:3, 62:8:14:3, 64:18:3:3, 6:73:21:3, 9:105:12:3, 9:94:26:3. Bridge to the field is antonymic (al-ghayb=hidden/absent vs al-shahaadah=manifest/present), not an in-verse equation.

reconciliation.rationale: At 25:72 'laa yashhaduuna l-zuura' the verb+object syntax underdetermines the pole: it reads equally as 'do not bear false witness' (attestation pole) or 'do not attend/be present at falsehood' (presence pole), an internal micro-indeterminacy the two-pole model predicts but cannot here resolve.

adversarial_verification.notes: A formal universal refutation was not run to a PASSED verdict because a genuine resistant seam already survives synthesis: the manifest-realm al-shahaadah (10x) is bridged to the field only by ghayb-antonymy inference, and 25:72 is an unresolved intra-field pole-ambiguity. The core witnessing nucleus is falsifiable (it predicts pole-by-complement, antonymy to al-ghayb, false testimony in range, presence-bound creaturely witnessing) and distinct from 'ilm/raqiib/bashiir, but because named occurrences resist, the honest status is NOT_RUN with those occurrences recorded in counterevidence_refs and RESISTANT_SEAM hard_cases rather than a PASSED claim of zero resistance.

independent_verification: Two build lenses (A: STRONG; B: single-nucleus) and one adversarial lens (C) independently agree the witnessing field is one bridged nucleus; C independently isolates the same manifest-realm seam, corroborating the recorded resistance.
candidate_root_contribution: sh-h-d marks a single relational field with two internally-linked poles: (P1) firsthand co-presence / being-manifest to an awareness (being there, attending, perceiving; for God, omniscient direct access), and (P2) the authoritative affirmation that issues from such direct access (vouching, attesting, affirming). The witness (shaahid/shahiid) occupies this relation; the verb (I/IV/X) enacts or causes it; shahaadah is either the act/content of the affirmation or the intake pole nominalized as 'the manifest'; mashhuud/mashhad is its object. Which pole surfaces is selected by complement type (time/place/event NP -> presence; 'anna'/'bi-'/'alaa' + proposition -> attestation), not by any change in the root's force.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 160 occurrences distribute across two poles: firsthand presence/attendance (2:185, 27:49, 43:19, 74:13, 4:72, 50:37, 2:133, 6:144) and authoritative affirmation (3:18, 63:1, 6:130, 2:282, 6:19, ashhaad at 11:18/40:51), with the manifest-realm domain-noun standing apart (10x).
layer_attribution.derivation: Forms I/IV/X and the participial/nominal series realize one relation: I enacts either pole by complement, IV causativizes both (18:51 make-present; 2:282 call-to-witness; 7:172 both), X procures witnesses; shaahid/shahiid are the agent, shahaadah the act/content, mashhuud/mashhad the object, ashhaad the collective attesters.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: shahaadah is the one member that lexically bifurcates: (a) testimony (act/content) and (b) the manifest realm; (b) has drifted furthest toward an autonomous term. The ADJ/N tag is inert across shahiid/shaahid and builds no class.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Complement type (time/place/event NP vs 'anna'/'bi-'/'alaa'+proposition) selects which pole surfaces; legal, cosmic, covenantal, and creedal framings are contextual instantiations and must NOT be mistaken for the root's contribution, which is the underlying presence<->affirmation relation itself.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Build lenses (root-wide unity) and the adversary (unity for the witnessing field but inferential bridge for the manifest realm) are reconciled by publishing a STRONG root-wide nucleus while carving the manifest-realm class out as a RESISTANT seam and downgrading 25:72 to RESISTANT.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The internal bridge for al-shahaadah=manifest-realm (10x) is inferential (ghayb-antonymy), not demonstrated, and 25:72 remains pole-ambiguous; both are recorded as first-class limits rather than smoothed into the nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: Genuine persisted resistance survives synthesis: the 10 ghayb/shahaadah manifest-realm occurrences are bridged to the field only by antonymy inference (the adversary withholds assent on the internal bridge), and 25:72 is an unresolved intra-field pole-ambiguity. rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A universal sh-h-d nucleus would be overturned if a Quranic occurrence forced a meaning outside the presence<->affirmation relation - e.g. if the honorific shuhadaa' (4:69, 57:19, 3:140) were internally forced to mean 'those slain in battle', or if the manifest-realm al-shahaadah were internally equated to an act of testifying rather than only inferred via ghayb-antonymy, or if a verb occurrence required 'know/see' with no presence and no affirmation.
rejection_condition.search_location: The honorific shuhadaa' cluster (4:69:14:3, 57:19:8:3, 3:140:20:1, 39:69:9:3), the 10 'aalimu l-ghaybi wa-l-shahaadah' occurrences, and the presence-only verb/nominal cases (2:185:14:1, 74:13:2:1, 4:72:17:1, 50:37:13:1).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate's verse_text and complement structure Quran-internally; test whether the presence pole, the affirmation pole, or their bridge (43:19, 12:81, 5:117, 2:133) still accounts for it without importing external lexica.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Hold the ADJ/N tag inert (parse artifact: shahiidan tagged both ways), and do not let contextual martyrdom/legal framings or classical glosses substitute for internal forcing; distinguish inference (antonymy) from internal equation.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If shuhadaa' were internally forced to 'slain' or the manifest-realm noun proved a true homonym, the UNIVERSAL claim collapses to REPRESENTATIVE (witnessing family) plus a separate lexeme, and research_state moves toward multi-class/UNRESOLVED for the affected class.

reopen_conditions: If Quran-internal evidence is found that equates al-shahaadah in 'aalimu l-ghaybi wa-l-shahaadah' (13:9, 23:92, 32:6, 39:46, 59:22, 62:8, 64:18, 6:73, 9:105, 9:94) to an act of witnessing/presence (not merely the ghayb-antonymy inference), promoting the manifest-realm class from RESISTANT to bridged.
If 25:72 'laa yashhaduuna l-zuura' is disambiguated by a parallel construction that fixes it to one pole (attend-falsehood vs bear-false-witness), resolving the recorded intra-field ambiguity.

If any honorific shuhadaa' occurrence (4:69:14:3, 57:19:8:3, 3:140:20:1) is shown Quran-internally to require 'one slain in God's cause', which would introduce a martyr sense currently held as a negative boundary.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A formal universal refutation was not run to a PASSED verdict because a genuine resistant seam already survives synthesis: the manifest-realm al-shahaadah (10x) is bridged to the field only by ghayb-antonymy inference, and 25:72 is an unresolved intra-field pole-ambiguity. The core witnessing nucleus is falsifiable (it predicts pole-by-complement, antonymy to al-ghayb, false testimony in range, presence-bound creaturely witnessing) and distinct from 'ilm/raqiib/bashiir, but because named occurrences resist, the honest status is NOT_RUN with those occurrences recorded in counterevidence_refs and RESISTANT_SEAM hard_cases rather than a PASSED claim of zero resistance.
